name: Field Shift projections and scenarios
status: model level; no web or backend
method: analog ensemble (Ensemble Streamflow Prediction, Day 1985): weather of each past year for the coming months, run month by month from the observed state; band = 5-95% of members + per-lead correction (conformalized, Romano et al. 2019) calibrated on Validation 2018-2022 hindcasts

scenarios.el_nino: only coastal El Nino years [1998, 2016, 2017, 2023, 2024] (Nino 1+2 > +1.0 C in Jan-Apr)
scenarios.drought_feb_mar: base with no rain in Feb and Mar 2026 and the driest surface soil of those months
scenarios.rain_half: base with rain x 0.5 every month
scenarios.rain_double: base with rain x 2 every month

beyond_useful_lead: show as 'a typical year' (climatology), not as a projection
not_for: crop yield, crop quality or exports (no yield data)
a weather forecast (the coming rain is not predicted)
a measurement of one field (one 2 km cell)
